## Walkthrough

Adds a new `@repo/database` package (clients, migrations, seeding, utilities, tests), local Postgres Docker compose and test envs, CI jobs for migration-check and integration-test, multiple ESLint and package.json updates, AI sandbox permission changes, a new routing debug endpoint and proxy export changes, plus assorted import/test tidy-ups.

## Sequence Diagram(s)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  actor DevCLI as Developer CLI
  participant ApplyScript as apply-migrations.ts
  participant Migrator as runMigrations()
  participant DB as PostgreSQL
  DevCLI->>ApplyScript: run CLI (e.g. npx node apply-migrations --verbose)
  ApplyScript->>Migrator: runMigrations({ verbose })
  Migrator->>DB: connect using DATABASE_URL (client-factory chooses Neon/local)
  Migrator->>DB: apply migrations (migrate)
  DB-->>Migrator: respond (success | error)
  Migrator-->>ApplyScript: return MigrationResult (success|failure, duration, path, error?)
  ApplyScript->>DevCLI: exit 0 on success / exit 1 on failure
  note right of Migrator: verbose toggles logging output during the process
```
